IRS990.Desc: ITIF is a nonpartisan research and educational institute - a think tank - whose mission is to formulate, evaluate, and promote policy solutions that accelerate innovation and boost productivity to spur growth, opportunity, and progress. ITIF focuses on a host of critical issues at the intersection of technological innovation and public policy - including in the areas of innovation and competitiveness; information technology and data; telecommunications; trade and globalization; and life sciences, agricultural biotechnology, and clean energy.
